name: Jellystat
description: Jellystat is a free and open source Statistics App for Jellyfin! (This project is still in development - expect some weirdness)

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Jwt secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-jellystat application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-jellystat
  # The `big-bear-jellystat` service definition
  big-bear-jellystat:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-jellystat
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:1.1.12@sha256:e61c759ec706da378bc8374e797da1dfd298ab30f804cefd82d192c301a888c7
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=big-bear-jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${SECRET_JWT_SECRET}
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/backup-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 3000 of the host to port 3000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    networks:
      - big-bear-jellystat-network
  big-bear-jellystat-db:
    container_name: big-bear-jellystat-db
    image: postgres:15.2@sha256:78a275d4c891f7b3a33d3f1a78eda9f1d744954d9e20122bfdc97cdda25cddaf
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: "jfstat"
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data # Mounting the volume
    networks:
      - big-bear-jellystat-network
networks:
  big-bear-jellystat-network:
    name: big-bear-jellystat-network
    driver: bridge
